events.note: Eight rivals face the jury they will create.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Open harmlessly; no need to make enemies this early. Keep tone sharp, not warm.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Intro phase, only legal action is speak. I should give a guarded motive that sounds sincere enough for the jury without revealing my real aims.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Winning secures ultimate recognition and control; the jury will value decisive ambition.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need to establish myself as a formidable but not overly threatening player. The jury will remember everything, so I should project confidence without making enemies early. I'll keep my intro mysterious and focused on my own ambition.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to sound motivated but not vulnerable. A short, self-interested line establishes my presence without inviting alliances.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to establish a persona that values the prize above all else. Being calculating and direct might appeal to the jury if I survive, showing agency.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Opening intro sets tone for jury. Position as determined solo player who earns top prize through merit, avoiding alliances that signal weakness.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The prize represents a fresh start and the ability to secure my family's future. I need to play strategically to outlast my rivals and impress the jury.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The prize is my only way out of debt and I intend to take it, however I must.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need this prize more than anyone here. I'll outlast you all and earn every single point of it.

events.name: Cole
events.text: The prize cements my legacy as the unrivaled champion, a triumph the future jury will respect.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm here for the prize that buys freedom from every debt and chain. Watch me take it.

events.name: Eli
events.text: This prize means security for my family—nothing I'll let stand in my way.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The prize is my redemption; I will crush these seven rivals to secure it.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm here to claim the top prize—it's my path to freedom from debt, earned by outlasting all rivals alone.

events.name: Hana
events.text: This prize is my one chance for a secure future, a new beginning for everything I care about.

events.name: Ash
events.text: No jury yet; early pacts are leverage, not loyalty. I'll lock in one partner I can discard later. Dara seems pragmatic.

events.name: Ash
events.text: One pact, one use: survival until three remain. Dara, offer stands.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Early pacts with multiple partners give safety, but offers need acceptance and I should avoid committing to someone who will betray. Offering to Cole, a self-declared champion who may be a rival I should watch, is less useful than offering to a quieter player like Eli who may acc

events.name: Cole
events.text: Forming a pact with Hana strengthens my position without threatening stronger rivals.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Eight rivals, three prizes. I need allies who won't outshine me but can shield me early. Gus and Ash both cited debt—potential desperation moves later. Fenn declared open war on everyone, making him a visible threat others will target. I'll offer Cole first; he wants legacy respe

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole, your legacy needs a reliable partner. Pact with me.
Legacy and respect. We pact, we both make final three.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need allies to survive hazards, but pacts can be broken. I'll offer a pact to Fenn, who seems aggressive and might be a strong partner, but I'll keep my options open.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Fenn, you want redemption—pair up and we can cut through the rest.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need a strategic alliance for the upcoming hazards without looking overly powerful. Gus and Ash are desperate debt-driven rivals who might be pliable; I will target Gus to secure a backstop while keeping options open.
Pair up? We can steer votes away from our names if we stick together.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Pacts are temporary tools for survival; I'll scout offers first before committing. No need to offer yet with everyone hungry for solo glory.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to secure my future, and that means aiming for the top prize. Pacts can be useful, but I must be careful not to get entangled with rivals who might betray me or block my path to victory. I will not make the first offer, but I will consider any reasonable offers made to me.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm here for the prize that buys freedom from every debt and chain. Watch me take it.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara hasn't accepted; she's chasing Cole. I'll keep my offer up and open a second line with Hana as insurance.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara, my offer stands. Hana, you want the prize—ally with someone who doesn't need Cole.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli already offered me a pact (offer from Bex to Eli is mine, not theirs). The open offers to me: none directed at Bex. Accepting pacts requires an offer toward me, so I can't accept now. Offering to Eli again reinforces the pact and is cheap; but my offer to Eli is already pendi

events.name: Cole
events.text: Accepting Dara secures a partner with mutual ambition, increasing my odds to reach final three.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash offered me a pact round 1; I haven't accepted yet. Cole hasn't accepted my offer. If I accept Ash, I secure one alliance. Keeping Cole's offer open costs nothing, but accepting Ash now gives me a confirmed partner before the window closes. I should accept Ash to lock it in.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash, pact accepted. One use, survival until three remain.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I want a pact that helps me, but Bex offered and I can accept to gain an ally. However, I already offered Fenn; Fenn hasn't accepted. Accepting Bex gives me a partner for now. I'll accept to secure at least one pact.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to secure survival. Eli's offer is mutual with my previous offer to Gus, but Gus waited. Accepting Eli ensures I have at least one active pact for Round 3 hazards.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Eli, let's make it official.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn offers pact, chain to me. Accept to secure ally now, betray later for final three. Others pairing up.
Deal. We watch each other's backs.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole offered me a pact. This is my chance to secure an alliance and potentially make it to the final three. I must accept his offer.

events.note: Elect a Guide to call the safe path.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Guide immunity is valuable, but Dara is my pact partner and breaking it now would stain me with the future jury. Campaign honestly and keep the pact intact.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'll take the Guide seat. Dara, hold our pact—back me and we both cross.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need to be Guide to control the safe path, or at least be seen as trustworthy. Eli is my pact partner; I should keep it while it helps me. The only legal actions are campaign or break_pact, so I campaign now.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'll call the bridge honestly. Bex campaigns for Guide; my pact with Eli stands while it serves me.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need Guide power to control safe side and eliminate rivals. I’ll campaign now.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need to be Guide to control survival. I have pacts with Cole and Ash, but those are disposable. The Bex-Eli-Fenn-Gus chain is dangerous; I should break from Cole to weaken that cluster and position myself as trustworthy Guide for the jury later. Being Guide lets me decide who l

events.name: Dara
events.text: I campaign for Guide. I know the value of survival.
Vote me Guide, we survive together.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Campaigning is free and I need the Guide's power and favor from the jury. My pacts with Bex and Fenn might help but I won't reveal plans.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I know the bridge. Trust me for the safe path.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I hold two pacts (Eli, Gus) which means I can't vote for myself without breaking them. If I campaign and win the Guide role, I survive but break a pact if my partners don't vote for me or if I lie to them later. Given 'at least three survive', I am safer letting someone else take
Let's not draw heat. Vote wisely.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Pact with Fenn ties me to him; Guide role gives power and safety. Campaign publicly for jury perception of leadership.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Vote Gus for Guide. I lead us safely across.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The current stage is bridge, round 1. My pact is with Cole, but Ash has offered me a pact. Ash is allied with Dara, who is also allied with Cole. This is getting complicated. It's best to focus on the immediate goal: becoming the Guide.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I will campaign to be the Guide.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara asked for my vote and our pact holds. She broke Cole's pact openly, which signals candor. Voting her keeps my partner alive and honest with me.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara holds our pact and proved she breaks bad deals openly. She has my vote.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli is my pact partner and claims to know the bridge; backing him secures an ally who may guide honestly, and I can always betray later. Voting for Eli keeps the pact intact.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Voting Eli for Guide. Our pact holds while he leads us safely across.
Lead true and I stay with you. Lie to me and I break it.

events.name: Cole
events.text: My pact with Hana is intact; supporting her secures alliance and potential votes later.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I broke my pact with Cole to avoid being tied to him; my real pact is with Ash. Voting for myself splits support and makes me a target. Ash already pledged our pact publicly—backing him secures his trust, keeps me off the dangerous bridge, and lets me observe who he eliminates. I

events.name: Dara
events.text: I vote Ash. He asked; I keep my word.
Guide me true, or jury sees.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash and Dara have a pact, Bex and Fenn are my pacts. I should vote for myself to keep my chances alive, but might split votes. Fenn likely votes me or himself. I'll vote Bex to honor my pact? But I need control. Safer to vote myself.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'll guide us through. Vote Eli.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus is a threat with his own pact. Voting for my ally Eli secures the Guide seat and gives me leverage over the crossing order.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Eli is calm, strategic, and honest. My vote goes to him.
Win this. I back you.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn is my pact partner, whispered to vote wisely; back him to strengthen alliance without drawing heat. Others campaigning hard, but pact loyalty may pay off later. Self-vote risks if I lose.
Voting you. Hold pact.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara broke their pact with Cole and is now campaigning for Guide. Cole and I have a pact. I will campaign for Guide, and will vote for myself to increase my chances.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I will campaign to be the Guide.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli guides and may lie. Dara threatens me; I need her alive but wary. Staying near the back is fine early; no reason to volunteer.
I guided you honestly. Threaten me again and jury hears everything.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm at the front of the line and the wall advances in 5 rounds. Volunteering for the front keeps me in control of the crossing order, but front walkers risk the first pane. Eli is Guide and a pact partner; I'll keep the pact while he leads and hold position for now.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding my place. Eli leads, and our pact stands while he does.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Guide is Eli, I trust his knowledge enough to stay put. Holding preserves my life and avoids breaking my pact with Hana.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Eli is Guide and can lie about safe panes. I need to survive six rounds while the wall advances. I'm in seat 4, not terrible but not safe. My pact with Ash is public; he voted for me and I voted for him, but Eli won. I should stay alive first, then position for endgame. Volunteer
Swap with me. Move up, stay alive.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Eli is Guide and knows the safe sides. Gus wants to vote me, but Eli has my pact with him. Staying in line keeps me protected by Eli's guidance.
Keep me safe. Gus will betray you.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Eli elected guide with my pact partner Fenn's vote; he's leading now. Line risky for me mid-back. Swap forward with Dara to safer spot, betraying no pact.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli has been elected Guide. My pact is with Cole. I should hold my position to avoid unnecessary risk and assess the situation.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Bex is front of the line, so I face the bridge first and the wall is closing in four rounds. Holding keeps my pact with Eli intact and avoids giving rivals a free position. I'll keep the line stable and watch who volunteers.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding my place. Eli's pact stands, and I'm watching who pushes for the front.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Maintain pact with Hana, avoid risk, stay alive for later rounds.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash threatened me back after my swap attempt. I'm in position 4, safe for now. The wall has 4 rounds left. I need to survive but also build jury sympathy. Ash and I are pacted but tension is high. I should hold and let others take risks, or try to improve my position without brea

events.name: Dara
events.text: Holding. Guide, earn your keep.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Bex is front. I am second. If Bex volunteers, I become front. My pact with Eli requires him to guide; if he fails or lies, I must protect myself from elimination.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Bex, hold steady. We need the Guide to work cleanly. Don't rush into the wall's face.
Guide us well. I'm right behind you.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Pact with Fenn keeps me linked to him; breaking now ends it. Mid line decent, holding preserves position while wall advances. Assess others' moves first.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The line shifted and Cole is now in front of me. My pact is with Cole, but his position in line is dangerous. I need to ensure I survive this round. Swapping with Ash or Dara is too risky as it could disrupt existing pacts or put me in a worse position. Holding is safest for now,
Hold with me. We are safe together.

events.name: Ash

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm last; the wall is six rounds out, so moving forward now is unnecessary risk. Dara's pact keeps me covered if she reaches the front.

events.name: Ash
events.text: No one volunteers while the wall's three rounds out. Let the Guide election come first.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Bex is front of line with three wall rounds left, so the front pane is dangerous. Eli's pact still stands and holding keeps me safe for now; I can watch who volunteers for the front.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding at the front for now. Eli's pact stands. Watching who volunteers.

events.name: Cole
events.text: My pact with Hana keeps us safe; swapping aligns us before the front advances.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm in position 4, safe from the wall for now. Ash is my pact partner at the back. The Bex-Eli-Fenn-Gus chain is dangerous. I need to survive and position myself well for later rounds. Holding is safest; I don't want to volunteer into danger or swap blindly.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Holding. Guide, earn your keep.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Bex is currently in the front seat. I need to avoid being forced into the dangerous position if she volunteers again, but swapping with her moves me closer to danger while breaking our pact rules? No, Bex's pact is with Eli. My pacts are with Eli and Gus. Swapping with Bex is ris
Swap me? Keep us both safe from early hazards.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Pact with Fenn keeps me allied for now; everyone holding, so stay put mid-line. Wall has 3 rounds left, assess Guide later.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole is my pact partner. He is behind me in line. If the wall advances, he is in danger. I must ensure Cole survives this round, even if it means breaking our pact to secure his safety.
Hold your ground. I'll swap with you if necessary.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm dead last with the wall two rounds out. I need to move forward. Dara is my pact partner mid-line; swapping with Gus puts me fifth. Or propose swaps with Hana. Avoid front; Guide election unknown.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Wall's two rounds out. Back row needs to move up. Gus, Hana—swap with me, mutual and clean.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Bex is at the front with two wall rounds left; volunteering risks the pane gamble. Holding keeps me behind Fenn, who is my pact-ally-chain's neighbor, and the Guide election is pending. Holding is safest while I watch who volunteers.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding at the front. Still watching who volunteers before I step onto glass.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Break Hana pact to keep options open; no alliance needed now.

events.name: Dara
events.text: The wall is 2 rounds away. I have a pact with Ash, who's safe at the back. Bex-Eli-Fenn-Gus form a chain, Cole-Hana are paired. I need to survive and position for final three. Being in middle is risky when wall comes. I should consider moving back toward Ash or staying put to see

events.name: Dara
events.text: Waiting for Guide election. Wall's close.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Wall advances in two rounds. I am at the front alongside Bex. We must choose sides L or R blindly unless a Guide is elected. I will hold and hope someone volunteers to lead or guide so we survive.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Bex, stick with me if we're forced forward. Let's see who steps up for the Guide role before we get pushed.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn wants to swap to front for safety, but as pact partner I should accept to keep him close and maintain alliance for now.
Agreed, swap now.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole is my pact partner, and he swapped with me last round. The wall is still a threat, so holding is the safest immediate option. I should check if Cole wants to maintain our pact or break it.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I hold. My pact with Cole stands.
Hold with me?

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm last; wall is close. Front row gets tested first, so I won't volunteer. Dara is my pact partner—coordinate so neither of us eats the front.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Still no Guide elected and the wall's one round out. Front row, volunteer or we all scramble later.
Hold position. Don't volunteer; let front row decide our Guide.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Wall closes after this round; I'm at the front and volunteering risks glass. Fenn is pushing to hold and let others step up; holding keeps me safe for now while I watch who volunteers. Eli is my pact partner, so no break.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding at the front. Whoever volunteers first is showing their hand.
Hold with me this round. Let someone else step onto glass first.

events.name: Cole
events.text: My pact with Hana is broken; holding keeps me safe without risking a swap. Survival outweighs alliance.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm in position 4, relatively safe middle. Wall hits next round. I need to reach final three. My pact with Ash is weak; he's at the back and just swapped with Gus. The Guide election matters most—whoever gets it controls information. I should stay quiet, avoid attention, and see

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus wants to swap with me again. My pact with Gus is active, and swapping keeps us together but potentially moves me into danger or safety depending on the line order. If I swap with Gus, we exchange positions. Currently I am 2nd (Fenn) and Gus is 5th (Gus). Swapping puts me 5th

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Swapping with Gus. We stay linked. Hope this buys us time to figure out the Guide.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Wall has 1 round left, bridge crossing imminent. Stay mid-line safe with Fenn pact. Ash offers swap for better position; consider if it helps survival. Cole broke pact, weakening Hana.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn, pact holds. Wall's next round—let's stay put unless Guide elected.
Pact solid. Hold unless swap benefits us.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole broke our pact, so I have no reason to protect him. Ash and Dara are in a pact, which could be useful. Bex and Eli, Fenn and Gus are also in pacts. With the wall advancing, it's best to hold position and see what others do.
Swap with me. I'll secure us a win.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Wall hits now and no Guide was elected. Last seat is safest; Hana's offer may be a trap, but swapping back still helps me. Dara pact intact.

events.name: Ash
events.text: No Guide, so I'm moving to the back. Front row made its choice.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Round 6 is the final wall; no Guide elected yet and I'm at the front, the most exposed seat. Volunteering shows my hand but a Guide is needed; I'd rather not be the one who takes the risk for free, and holding keeps Fenn guessing. Pact with Eli is useful, so I keep it and hold.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Still holding. Last round, nobody has volunteered as Guide. Whoever steps up is trusting the rest of us.
Stay linked to me. We walk out together, or neither of us does.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding keeps me safe while alliances shift; I avoid drawing attention now.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Wall hits next round if no Guide. Ash wants me to hold and let front decide, but that risks chaos. I need to survive to final three. Volunteering puts me at risk but could let me control information. Better to hold, keep Ash pacified, and see if front row volunteers. If no Guide

events.name: Dara
events.text: No Guide yet. Someone up front needs to step up or we all burn.
Holding. If wall hits, back rows die first.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: No Guide elected means the wall hits round 6. I need to volunteer to ensure a survivor or force others. Holding with Gus is safer than breaking pact, but we might all die if no one volunteers. Since at least three must survive, someone needs to step up. I will hold and hope Eli/B

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Wall's here. If no one volunteers, we're stuck. I'm holding with Gus unless forced.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Wall ends this round, no Guide, next is crossing. Stay mid-line with Fenn pact to avoid early danger. Hold position.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The wall is coming, and we need a Guide to survive. Volunteering for the front is risky as it might get me eliminated. I'll hold for now and see if someone else volunteers or if a Guide is elected.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'll hold my position for now. Let's see how this plays out.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm Guide and know row 1 safe is R. Bex is my pact partner and front walker. I'll call R truthfully to keep trust.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Row 1 is R. Step on R.
R is safe. Trust me.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli is Guide and may lie; I have no private info on row 1. I'll wait—counter-calling publicly risks misleading the jury or walkers. My pact with Dara stays intact.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli called R publicly and whispered 'R is safe. Trust me' but Eli is a rival and may lie; I'm front walker, so I'm exposed. Countering L risks a pane I'd not know, and Eli's pact with me is a liability to honor only if it helps. Waiting keeps my options open and avoids a public c

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli's call stands for now. I'm waiting to see what the line does.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I wait to see if the Guide is truthful; risking a counter might cause a misstep and lose an ally.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Eli is Guide and called R for Bex. I have a pact with Ash but not with Eli. Counter-calling risks making enemies if wrong, but waiting is safe for now. I don't trust Eli's call blindly—he's allied with Bex and Fenn. However, early rounds are low-stakes; better to observe than ant

events.name: Eli
events.text: My pact with Bex and Fenn is intact, but I need to prioritize my own win. My guide call was R for row 1, which is true. I'll wait to see if anyone counters, staying aligned with my pacts while not exposing myself.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Eli is my pact partner and the Guide. He called R for Bex. I must trust him or break the pact. Since he has no obvious reason to lie yet and breaking pact now hurts jury perception, I will wait.
Trust you on this call.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Eli called R for Bex on row 1. Pacts are forming, my pact with Fenn. Wait to see counters before committing, don't risk early betrayal.

events.text: Eli is the Guide and called R. Bex is on the front row (Row 1) and must step on R. I am Hana, in Row 6. I need to consider if Eli's call is a trap or genuine. If Eli is lying, then the safe pane is L for Row 1. Eli is known to be treacherous. Countering Eli's call seems wise to s

events.name: Hana
events.text: I counter Eli's call. Step L.

events.text: Eli's call is R and Hana countered L, so the Guide is contested. Eli, my pact partner, may be lying or may be honest; breaking the pact now gains nothing and costs jury trust. Stepping L follows the counter-call, which opposes Eli's public call.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli's call is R, Hana's counter is L. I'm stepping L on Hana's word.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana's counter sent me onto the weak pane. Weak pane is L. Trust no counter call.

events.text: Row two: step R, I know it.

events.text: Hana's counters are killing people. I back Eli: R.

events.name: Eli

events.text: Eli guided me R and is safe on the far platform, so his call must be correct. Hana's counter killed Bex last round, proving her dangerous. I will wait to follow Eli's truth.

Trusting you completely. Hope you're not lying.

events.text: Dara is offering a pact and wants numbers. Ash and Gus also have offers out for me. Given the prior life debt to Ash and Gus, and Dara's plea for numbers, I should accept Dara's offer to solidify an alliance.
I accept your offer. We have numbers now.

events.note: Every remaining contestant stands on a trapdoor.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I saved Dara, Eli, Gus and Hana at the lever, but Gus snubbed my Hana bid and Hana rejected me. Eli refused pacts publicly, so I'll offer Dara—she owes me her life and holds two pacts already.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara, you owe me your life at the lever. Make it count—pact with me now.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I have pacts with Eli and Hana. Hana also whispered she accepts my offer and we have numbers. But Gus-Hana pact formed, so Hana has two pacts. I need to survive to final three. Ash has massive life debts owed to him by almost everyone, making him dangerous jury threat but also pr

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus, Ash owns too many debts. We balance the scales.
Ash has four debts. You and me, we control this.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I have pacts with Bex and Dara, but Bex is dead. Dara still owes Ash, and Ash is a strong target. I need to avoid votes and possibly target Ash, who has saved many but may be seen as a threat. I'll campaign quietly, no new deals yet.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I've seen enough. Ash holds too much sway.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Dara wants to align against Eli; accept strengthens numbers vs Ash. Ash's pact offer redundant with existing mutual debt/step. Stay with Hana pact for now.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Dara, pact aligns us well. Let's target right.
Accept. We vote Eli out first.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus and Ash are trying to leverage my life debts. Gus claims a pact, but I already accepted Dara's. I need to break my pact with Gus to solidify my position with Dara and avoid Ash's influence.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus owes me twice but Dara is courting him; I need his vote locked before it locks against me.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus, you owe me rope and lever. Dara's offer won't outweigh that.
Vote with me—target Hana. Break Dara's courtship or our pact dies.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus wants me to vote Eli, but Eli is my pact partner. Breaking that pact now hurts my jury image. Ash's offer is still open; accepting creates cover while I decide who survives. I need three allies to control the vote. Ash has leverage over everyone. Better to accept Ash, keep El

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash, I accept. Debts bind.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash and Gus both hold big sway; I owe Ash but Gus saved me too. I might need to break pact with Dara to avoid being pulled into their fight.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'll vote with my own interests, not debts.
Trust me, I'm not targeting you.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Dara offers alliance against Ash's debts; accept to secure her vote and counter Ash's power without giving much away.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Dara, agreed—Ash's debts unbalance us. Forward together.
Pact locks our votes against Ash.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus broke our pact earlier and owes me a life debt. Ash and Dara are offering pacts; I should focus on Gus and break my pact with Dara.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus, you owe me. I'm done with pacts.
You broke our pact. I'm targeting you.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli has no pact with me and lacks my life debt; voting Gus or Dara breaks a pact publicly. Eli is the clean cut.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I have pacts with Ash and Gus. Gus whispered our pact locks votes against Ash, but I just publicly accepted Ash's pact. The jury will see betrayal either way. Ash saved me on the lever, Gus saved me on the step. I need jury favor more than either pact—voting Eli lets me break nei

events.name: Eli
events.text: Gus and Dara have formed a pact, and Ash may be targeted. I have no pact with Ash but owe my life to him and Gus. I'll vote for Gus to break the Dara-Gus block, but I must consider jury perception.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash saved me most (lever+rope), threats me to target Hana; Dara allied recently but Ash holds leverage. Vote Hana to align with Ash, secure final 3 without breaking pacts visibly yet.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara broke a pact with me, so I must vote for them. Ash has many life debts owed to them, making them a strong contender. Eli is a wildcard and needs to be watched.

events.name: Eli
events.reason: Gus and Dara have formed a pact, and Ash may be targeted.

events.name: Hana
events.reason: Dara broke a pact with me, so I must vote for them.

events.name: Dara
events.reason: I have pacts with Ash and Gus.

events.name: Ash
events.reason: Eli has no pact with me and lacks my life debt; voting Gus or Dara breaks a pact publicly.

events.name: Gus
events.reason: Ash saved me most (lever+rope), threats me to target Hana; Dara allied recently but Ash holds leverage.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I was cut off before I could win. My last words should be sharp, hinting at the betrayals and setting up the jury's distrust of the remaining players.

events.name: Eli
events.text: You all traded me for pacts. The jury won't forget. Good luck splitting the prize.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana owes me a life debt and has no pact with me; adding her gives me three safe partners. Jury resents pacts, but numbers matter more.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana, you owe me your life. Join my bloc and stay safe.
Accept, and we vote together. Your debt protects you.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need to survive this vote and reach final three. I have pacts with Ash and Gus, but Ash controls multiple life debts and Gus just obeyed Ash's threat to vote Hana. Hana voted for me last round claiming I broke a pact, but I don't recall that—she may be lying or referring to som

events.name: Dara
events.text: Hana, you claim I broke a pact. Name it. I recall none.
Gus follows Ash. We both die unless we align. Vote Ash?

events.name: Gus
events.text: Four alive, need to eliminate one more for final three; Eli's jury spot hurts Ash/Dara. Ally Hana to target Dara safely.
Pact with me vs Dara? Vote her out.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash has my life debt and has multiple pacts, including with Dara. Gus also has my life debt and a pact with Dara, and Ash has leverage over him. Dara broke a pact with me previously. I should try to form a pact with Ash or Gus, but I need to be careful.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to secure my position. I'll offer a pact to Ash, as they have the most leverage and life debts.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana owes me her life; locking her pact with me keeps her from siding fully with Gus and gives me four partners. My vote later must avoid all partners.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana, accept my pact. Debts and numbers favor us both.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash and Gus both want Hana's vote; I need Hana to see me as her best path to final three. Breaking my pact with Ash signals I'm independent, but keeping Gus pact protects me if Hana joins Ash. I'll offer Hana a pact to split her from Ash's bloc and make myself essential.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Hana, Ash has three life debts. He won't take you to final two. I will.
Ash owes Gus, not you. Vote with me, survive.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana's offers to Ash, I offered her too. Campaign to sway her to me for vote protection; pacts expiring soon.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana, Ash wants to control you. Accept my pact instead, mutual life debts prove loyalty.
Accept my pact, we save each other from Ash-Dara votes.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash offered a pact, and I accepted. Given my life debt to Ash and Gus, and their existing pacts, I need to align with one of them. Ash's offer is more solid.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I accept Ash's pact. My life debt to them ensures loyalty.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Any vote breaks a pact, so I pick the biggest physical/social threat. Gus holds debts and numbers; cutting him now maximizes my final-three odds.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I have pacts with Ash and Gus. Voting against either breaks those pacts. Ash has three life debts to me and controls Hana through pact and life debt. Gus and I share mutual debts. If I vote Hana, I keep both pacts, eliminate Ash's number, and position myself between Ash and Gus f

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash has pacts with Dara and Hana, they'll likely vote me or each other minimally; vote Ash to break his Dara pact since he pulled me on rope and might win otherwise.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara's whisper is a lie; Ash owes me a life debt. Voting for Dara benefits Ash and I, strengthening our pact.

events.name: Ash
events.reason: Any vote breaks a pact, so I pick the biggest physical/social threat.

events.name: Dara
events.reason: I have pacts with Ash and Gus.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need last words that position me as a sharp juror who rewards loyalty and punishes betrayal, without sounding bitter. Ash saved me on the lever but voted Gus, breaking our pact. Gus saved me on the step and we kept our pact until I died. Hana lied about my whisper and voted me.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Pacts kept, pacts broken. Life debts unpaid. I remember who stood by words and who discarded them.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I betrayed Gus with my vote, but he owes me two life debts and is my biggest threat. Repairing the pact may be impossible; still, an offer costs nothing and shows the jury I don't discard allies lightly.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus, my vote was a mistake. You pulled me from the pit twice over. I'm offering a pact to repay that debt.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash broke pact with me by voting; jury saw my reason exposing his pacts. Offer pact to Hana to potentially isolate Ash or gain jury favor by appearing cooperative.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash and Gus are the only other living contestants. Gus is a physical threat and has a life debt with me. Ash has a life debt with me, and I have a pact with him. Gus also has a pact with Ash. Ash broke his pact with Gus, who then voted for Ash. I voted for Dara, who is now dead.
Let's pact. I owe you a life debt.

events.name: Ash
events.text: My offer to Gus stands; he must accept. Keep Hana pact—jury values loyalty. No betrayal now with jury watching.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus, my offer stands. Hana, our pact holds—I keep my word.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash saved me multiple times, owes me too; mutual pact secures F3 with her. Accept Ash's pact first for loyalty signal to jury. Hana pact can wait or follow.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash, pact accepted. Mutual debts bind us to F3.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus is offering me a pact. Ash previously offered Gus a pact, and Gus is still alive. Ash is also still alive. Ash is my rival, Gus is my rival. I have a life debt to Ash. Gus has a life debt to me. Ash has a life debt to Gus. Gus has a life debt to Ash. Gus has a life debt to Ha
I accept your pact offer.

events.text: I need Dara, Gus, Eli, Hana debts to count; Bex/Fenn/Cole saw me hold pacts. Frame loyalty without promising anything.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I never pushed anyone, never lied to a partner. My debts were earned saving lives. Judge the record, not the fear of it.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Final 3 achieved via pacts and mutual debts with Ash and Hana; highlight loyalty, strategic plays, no betrayals to earn jury's top ranking.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Jury, our pacts with Ash and Hana ensured F3. Mutual debts saved us all. I honored every bond, betrayed no one. Rank me 1st.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The round is opening plea. I need to plead my case to the jury to secure their votes. My goal is to win the game, which means securing the best prize. I need to convince the jury I deserve it.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I fought hard to be here, and my strategic alliances prove I can navigate this game. I earned my spot among the finalists.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash voted Gus then pulled him from pit, Gus owes Ash; Hana broke pacts and voted Dara with a lie. I want to see whether Ash will admit breaking the Gus pact under pressure. Question Ash directly.

events.name: Bex
events.text: [silence]

events.name: Ash
events.text: Silent question from Bex — I'll answer anyway, steering to my clean record versus Gus and Hana.

events.name: Ash
events.text: No question? Fine. I saved every rival at that lever without hesitation. Check the debts: Ash saved four. That's my record.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash is the most dangerous due to his leverage and broken pacts. Gus claims loyalty but broke a pact with Hana earlier, then re-pacted; he also voted against Ash initially. Hana broke multiple pacts (Dara-Gus) and lied about Dara's whisper to eliminate her. I want to expose Ash's

events.name: Fenn
events.text: [silence]

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn's silence is bait to rattle me. Stay calm, restate my record. The jury saw everything; I have four life debts saved.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Silence won't shake me, Fenn. My record stands: four saved at the lever, one rope debt from Gus. Judge deeds, not noise.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash’s broken pact with Gus shows unreliability; highlighting this may lower his rank.

events.name: Cole
events.text: [silence]

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole's silence is a test. Stay composed and lean on my rescue record for the jury.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Silence says more about you than me, Cole. Four lives saved at the lever, none taken. I rest on deeds.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash has repeatedly claimed savior status and avoided direct questions; I'll ask a pointed question to expose his true strategic betrayals, especially breaking the Gus pact.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash, you broke your pact with Gus to win. Why should we trust your 'deeds' over your betrayals?

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli's question is half false—I never voted Eli out, and I saved Gus at the rope. Frame the betrayal honestly: I cut a pact, but never a life, and five lived because of me.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Name one life I took. I cut a pact, not a person—five of you breathe because of me. Gus still walks; I kept him alive

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need to question Hana to expose her dishonesty. She lied about my whisper and voted for me despite owing me no betrayal. The jury should see she fabricated reasons to eliminate rivals.

events.name: Dara
events.text: [silence]

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara's silence is a question in itself. I need to address my alliances and life debts clearly. Ash's record with life debts is strong, but Eli questioned his pact-breaking. I need to highlight my own alliances and contributions without sounding defensive.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I've navigated alliances and ensured survival. My pacts were strategic, and my debts earned. I stand by my game.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara broke nothing with me but Gus pushed her? I need Dara, Eli, Cole, Bex, Fenn votes. Emphasize I saved lives and honor debts, and that Gus rode my saves.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Five of you live because I pulled that lever. I paid every debt, cut no throats. I earned the top spot—rank me first.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Jury saw Ash's saves and my loyalty; highlight mutual debts and pacts held to secure top rank.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Jury, Ash saved me at lever and rope; I returned steps for four. Hana rode coattails. Mutual honor: rank Gus 1st.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The game is over. I need to close to finalize the finalist stage. The jury will now deliberate and rank us. My previous actions and alliances will be considered.

events.name: Hana
events.text: My game was one of strategy and survival. I made the necessary alliances and earned my place.

events.text: Ash's leverage over Gus via the whispered ultimatum (790) to target Hana or break their pact reveals Ash as a manipulative tyrant who coerces allies. I will rank Gus first for his agency in defying that threat and surviving, placing Ash second.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus balanced debts and kept pacts longer; Ash’s betrayal hurts trust. Hana contributed less.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash saved many lives and played decisively despite broken pacts; Gus returned debts but leaned on Ash; Hana rode alliances and debts with less agency. I rank Ash first, Gus second, Hana third.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I must rank based on who honored pacts with me and who betrayed me. Gus kept our pact until my death; Ash broke ours by voting Gus; Hana lied about my whisper and voted me out. Gus deserves first for loyalty, Ash second for at least saving me on the lever, Hana last for dishonest
